infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LM Compliance uses your location to automatically tag the shop address on scans, so inspection records include the correct district and state.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: LM Compliance uses your location to tag scans with the correct district and state.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow LM Compliance to use the camera to scan product labels.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow LM Compliance to access your photos to upload product labels.
